parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token to start the next query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the resource resides. Call [DescribeRegions](~~364379~~) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource ID. A maximum of 50 IDs can be specified.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. The only valid value is `instance`.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: A list of tags. The list can contain a maximum of 20 tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key. Constraints:

- Cannot be empty.

- A maximum of 128 characters in length.

- Cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\`.

- Cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value. Constraints:

- A maximum of 128 characters in length.

- Cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\`.

- Cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`.
